messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 2015 年的世界国际象棋锦标赛（World Chess Championship）最终冠军是 **马格努斯·卡尔森**（Magnus Carlsen）。他在与俄罗斯选手谢尔盖·加里金（Sergey Karjakin）的对决中，以总分 12½‑11½ 获胜，成功卫冕了自己的王座。

But maybe they refer to some other tournament like Chinese national championship or something else. But likely world championship. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.

We can also mention details: He defended his title against Karjakin with score 12½-11½ after tie-breaks. Provide context. Use Chinese as question is Chinese. Should respond in Chinese. No need to call tool because it's straightforward knowledge.
